brief:
A top official within the Board of Peace said Monday that escalating violence in Gaza and the occupied West Bank makes a two-state solution "impossible," Middle East Eye reported. The official attributed the assessment to a failure to advance in Gaza paired with rising tensions across Palestinian territories.

The statement comes as violence continues across multiple fronts in the region. Diplomatic efforts toward a two-state arrangement have faced mounting pressure from ongoing conflict and settlement expansion in occupied Palestinian land.

title: UN official calls two-state solution impossible amid Gaza, West Bank escalation
